items.hed: Texans are on their bye, with the next game Nov. 8 at the Chargers
items.insight: The Houston Texans schedule lists Sunday, Oct. 25, as a home game against the New York Giants at Reliant Stadium, kickoff 12:00 p.m. CT, on FOX. Week 8, the weekend of Nov. 1, is marked no game. The team page does not post a final score for Sunday, so none is printed here. Next game listed is Nov. 8 at the Los Angeles Chargers, 3:05 p.m. CT, on CBS, at SoFi Stadium.
